userSpecifiedSources: Baseball Savant ABS challenge leaderboard (MLB Advanced Media): https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/leaderboard/abs-challenges . Player columns: MLB StatsAPI (https://statsapi.mlb.com, /people and season stats) and Baseball Savant Statcast search (https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/statcast_search) and catcher-framing leaderboard. Collected with savant-extras 0.6.0 (https://pypi.org/project/savant-extras/) by build.py in https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets (abs-challenges-dataset), which fails without writing anything unless every gate in the dataset description passes.

abs_challenges_players.csv.description: Baseball Savant's ABS (Automated Ball-Strike) challenge leaderboard, 15 boards: MLB 2025 spring training (the test), Triple-A 2025 and 2026 regular season, MLB 2026 spring training and regular season, each for batters, pitchers and catchers as the challenger. One row per player per board, keyed by the MLBAM player_id (Savant's own CSV export has no id). Boards were fetched with a minimum of 0 challenges, so players Savant counts pitches for but who never challenged are included. Columns ending in _against describe challenges made against the player's side. Collected with the savant-extras Python package (0.6.0). Added per player, for the board's own level, season and game type: bio (bats, throws, age, height, weight, position, debut) and season stats from MLB StatsAPI (api_bat_, api_pit_, api_c_), and Statcast search aggregates (sc_bat_, sc_pit_, sc_c_: plate discipline, chase and zone swing rates, xwOBA, exit velocity, and for catchers the called-strike rate on taken pitches outside the zone and called-ball rate inside it).

columns.challenge_type: Who challenged on this board: batter, pitcher or catcher.
columns.player_id: MLB Advanced Media (MLBAM) player id. Joins to Statcast batter / pitcher / fielder_2.
columns.player_name: Player name as shown by Baseball Savant.
columns.team_abbr: Team abbreviation at the board's level (the Triple-A club on AAA boards, the MLB club on MLB boards); one team is shown when n_teams > 1.
columns.parent_org: Abbreviation of the MLB parent organisation (equals team_abbr on MLB boards).
columns.game_type: Added by this dataset: R = regular season, S = spring training.
columns.n_total_sample: Savant's sample size for the player on this board; the denominator of rate_challenges.
columns.exp_chal_runs_gained: Savant's expected run value from overturned challenges.
columns.exp_chal_runs_lost: Savant's expected run value lost on failed challenges.
columns.n_chal_reasonable_opps: Savant's count of reasonable challenge opportunities.
columns.n_chal_runs: Run value of the challenges = n_chal_runs_gained - n_chal_runs_lost.
columns.n_chal_runs_gained: Savant's run value gained on overturned challenges (never negative).
columns.n_chal_runs_lost: Savant's run value lost on failed challenges (never negative).
columns.net_chal_gained_runs: Savant's net runs on overturned challenges vs expected. Equals n_chal_runs_gained - exp_chal_runs_gained on batter boards; on most pitcher and catcher rows it does not, and Savant's formula there is not reproduced here.
columns.net_chal_lost_runs: Savant's net runs on failed challenges vs expected. Equals n_chal_runs_lost - exp_chal_runs_lost on batter boards; on most pitcher and catcher rows it does not, and Savant's formula there is not reproduced here.
columns.n_strikeouts: Savant's strikeout count on the board.
columns.n_walks: Savant's walk count on the board.
columns.player_team: Savant's numeric team id for team_abbr (equals parent_org_code on MLB boards).
columns.n_teams: Number of teams the player appeared for on this board (1-4).
columns.n_levels: Number of levels on this board (always 1).
columns.player_at_bat: Equals player_id; filled on batter boards only.
columns.parent_org_code: Numeric MLB team id of the parent organisation.
columns.levelCode: Savant's raw level code: "1" on MLB boards, the string "Triple-A" on AAA boards.
columns.rate_overturns: n_overturns / n_challenges (empty when there are no challenges).
columns.rate_chal_reasonable: n_chal_reasonable / n_challenges (empty when there are no challenges).
columns.runs_gained_per_chal: n_chal_runs_gained / n_challenges (empty when there are no challenges).
columns.overturns_vs_exp: net_net_chal - net_net_chal_against: the player's own net overturns vs expected, minus the same for challenges made against the player's side.
columns.uniqueId: Savant's row key: player_id and year joined by an underscore.
columns.pitcher: Equals player_id; filled on pitcher boards only.
columns.pitcher_against: Equals pitcher where filled; pitcher boards only.
columns.fielder_2: Equals player_id; filled on catcher boards only (Statcast's catcher column).
columns.fielder_2_against: Equals fielder_2 where filled; catcher boards only.

abs_aaa2025_to_mlb2026.csv.description: Players on both the Triple-A 2025 and the MLB 2026 regular-season boards (batters and catchers, joined on player_id), with the same challenge measures side by side: columns ending in _aaa2025 come from Triple-A 2025, columns ending in _mlb2026 from MLB 2026. Only players with at least one pitch in Savant's sample (n_total_sample > 0) on each side are included. Pitchers are left out: Triple-A pitchers made 5 challenges in all of 2025. Bio columns appear once; season stats and Statcast aggregates (api_bat_, api_c_, sc_bat_, sc_c_) appear for each side with the same suffix.
